# Under the griffin rule, men at war keep griffin riders at a tenth of the arms
zin_default_air_griffins = {
	allowed = {
		always = yes
	}
	enable = {

		zin_rules_skies_beasts = yes
		has_war = yes
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

		type = unit_ratio

		value = 10
	}
}
